_comment: Source registry. Verified 2026-08-02 — see FEEDS_REPORT.md. Loaded at runtime by SourceRegistry; a remote override may replace this file wholesale later. Never hardcode a feed URL in Kotlin.
_priority: Tie-break only: when two outlets publish the same story at the identical timestamp, the LOWER priority wins the dedupe. Not a display order.

sources.name: الجزيرة
sources.notes: No per-item images ever. Channel-level <image> is the site logo — must not be adopted. Has <category>. Feed lags its own sitemap by ~3.5h; the 6h freshness band (D14) is what lets it contribute — it now supplies 3 of 23 accepted items. See _aljazeera_googlenews_alternative below before switching adapters.

_alternativeUrls.aliases: https://www.aljazeera.net/rss and /feed return this identical feed

sources._comment: READY-TO-FLIP ALTERNATIVE for aljazeera_ar, kept disabled. To switch: set this entry's enabled=true and the rss entry above to false. MEASURED AND NOT RECOMMENDED — the Google News site: query returns navigational pages rather than articles ('البث الحي المباشر', 'إذاعة الجزيرة: استمع الآن', the section homepage), local URL decoding fails on every item so each one costs an extra HEAD redirect (30 per sync at when:6h), and its index is still ~98 minutes behind. The RSS feed above, once the 6h band admits it, delivers real articles at no extra cost. See DECISIONS.md D15.

sources.name: فرانس 24
sources.notes: Was /ar/rss, which is DEAD — it 301s to the /ar/خدمة-RSS landing page and returns HTML, so it parsed to zero items and the source contributed nothing while reporting only an 'intermittent empty 200'. That quirk was never intermittent; the catch-all feed was retired. Verified 2026-08-04: this section feed returns 30 items, 100% media:thumbnail coverage, RFC-822 GMT dates, all-https links. Sibling section feeds also live if broader coverage is ever wanted: /ar/europe/rss, /ar/france/rss, /ar/americas/rss, /ar/asia-pacific/rss, /ar/business/rss. /ar/africa/rss is 404.
sources._deadUrl: https://www.france24.com/ar/rss — 301 to an HTML page, zero items

sources.name: دويتشه فيله
sources.notes: Chose xml/ (RSS 2.0, pubDate) over spec's rdf/ (RDF, dc:date) — same content, one parser path. No images. Tail of feed is months stale; sort by parsed date, never feed order.

sources.name: رويترز
sources.notes: DISABLED — Reuters no longer runs an Arabic service. RSS 404, arabic.reuters.com DNS-dead, site 401, frontend JSON API 401, Google News site: query returns 0 items. A broad 'رويترز' keyword query returns other outlets citing Reuters, which would misattribute them — deliberately not used. Flip enabled=true if Reuters ever relaunches.
